page.content:
Pacifist airbenders wiped out at the war's start.

How Air Nomads connects

  • Character: Aang — Aang is the last surviving Air Nomad.
  • Event: Sozin's Comet — The comet attack is what ended the Air Nomads as a people.

What is Air Nomads?

The Air Nomads were the monastic people of the air temples, Aang's people, erased in Fire Lord Sozin's comet attack that opened the Hundred Year War.

Key threads lead to Aang and Sozin's Comet.
